blocks.text: BINMALEY, Pangasinan – A cyclist died after he was accidentally struck from behind by a motorcycle rider along a provincial road in Barangay Camaley in Binmaley, Pangasinan, on Thursday morning. The cyclist was a married, unemployed resident of Binmaley who was steering a black bicycle. He was not wearing a protective helmet. The accident happened at about 9:20 a.m. as the cyclist and the motorcycle rider were traveling north.
